nodes.label: Qutrub Open-Source Arabic Verb Conjugator
nodes.description: Rule-based morphological engine for generating full conjugation tables of Arabic verbs across tense, voice, and mood, enabling accurate lexical matching in NLP pipelines.

nodes.label: IETF RFC 8554 Leighton-Micali Hash-Based Signatures (LMS)
nodes.description: Post-quantum stateful hash-based digital signature system utilizing Merkle trees over Leighton-Micali one-time signatures, providing secure cryptographic audit trails.

nodes.label: AMD Secure Encrypted Virtualization-Secure Nested Paging (SEV-SNP)
nodes.description: Hardware-enforced confidential computing architecture providing strong memory integrity protection, guest state isolation, and hardware attestation against hypervisor-level attacks.

nodes.label: W3C JSON-LD 1.1 A JSON-based Serialization for Linked Data
nodes.description: W3C Recommendation defining a JSON-based format to serialize Linked Data using contexts, enabling semantic graph exchange over standard web APIs.

nodes.label: Tarjan's Strongly Connected Components Algorithm
nodes.description: Graph topology analysis algorithm utilizing depth-first search (DFS) to identify strongly connected components in directed graphs, optimizing knowledge graph cycle detection.
